title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Certificate Fee Retention Schedule
content:
| Premium on the certificate's issue entry | Kept from the loan-event credit |
|---|---|
| Below 1000 dollars | Nothing |
| At least 1000 dollars and below 5000 dollars | 75 dollars |
| 5000 dollars or more | 100 dollars |

**Certificate fee retention — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, loan-event schedule.** The certificate's issuance fee is fully earned, so Tidemark keeps, without taking the loan-event credit below zero, 100 dollars of it when the certificate's premium on its issue entry is 5000 dollars or more, 75 dollars when that premium is at least 1000 but below 5000 dollars, and nothing when it is below 1000 dollars.

The premium read is the one on the issue entry, even where a later renewal entry carries a different premium. A premium of exactly 1000 dollars keeps 75 dollars; exactly 5000 dollars keeps 100 dollars.
